import { Processor, WorkerHost } from '@nestjs/bullmq';
import { Job } from 'bullmq';

// S0_SOURCE:bullmq-report-worker-consumer
throw new Error('S0 BullMQ consumer fixture must never execute');

@Processor('reports')
export class ReportWorker extends WorkerHost {
  async process(job: Job): Promise<unknown> {
    if (job.name === 'generate-pdf') return { generated: true };
    return null;
  }
}
